title: Dak Prescott throws for a season-high 355 in Week 4

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dak Prescott throws for a season-high 355 in Week 4
sources.description: Dak Prescott relied heavily on CeeDee Lamb en route to a Week 4 win over Houston, throwing for 355 yards and the game-winning touchdown.
